## Quarto

```{r}
## Load packages
library(tidyverse) ## Functions for loading and manipulating data
library(here) ## This will help tell R where to find the data file

## Load the data
bob <- read_excel(here("data", "all_data.xlsx")) ## "Here" lets you specify a filepath relative to the project root

## Remove participants who didn't complete the task
## (Specifically, remove anyone who is missing a value for any variable: age, gender, task response, etc)
bob2 <- bob |> drop_na()

bob2 |> count(quest_ver)
## This yields 2290 participants -- 68 more than the 2222 reported in the paper.
## There are 79 participants with questionnaire versions 5-10. (2222 - 79 = 2211

## Following the authors' codebook, keep only participants who completed questionnaire version 1-4
bob3 <- bob2 |> filter(quest_ver %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
## This yields 2211 participants -- 11 fewer than the 2222 reported in the paper.

## Code handedness
bob3 <- bob3 |> mutate(
  handedness = case_when(
    hand_score < 0 ~ "Left",
    hand_score > 0 ~ "Right"
  )
)
```

```{r}
## Reproduce Table 1
bob3 |> group_by(lab) |> 
  count()
```

```{r}
## Summarize age
bob |> 
  summarize(age = mean(age))


```
